caption: The drawing features three brass-colored escutcheon plates with ornamental handles, arranged vertically on a light beige background and framed by a simple double-line border. Each plate has a central keyhole and decorative designs on each side of the keyhole. The top escutcheon is an ornate, symmetrical design with an oval-shaped keyhole in the center and two circular openwork motifs on either side; a round, flat keyhole cover hangs on a small axis to the left, with a ring-shaped drop handle attached. The middle and bottom escutcheons are more geometric and symmetrical, each with a vertically oriented teardrop-shaped keyhole, a round or rectangular plate cover on one side, and a rounded D-shaped handle hanging from attachments. Brass highlights and shadows are depicted throughout the plates and handles, simulating a metallic sheen. A small linear scale in inches is present in the bottom right corner, and the artist’s name “HANS KORSCH” is inscribed in the lower left corner.
title: Three Door Handles
